name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on floor with upper back against a bench, padded barbell across hips.
Feet flat, hip-width apart with shins vertical at top of movement.
Drive hips upward through heels until torso and thighs form a straight bridge.
Squeeze glutes hard at the top for 1 full second, then lower with control.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending lumbar spine instead of driving with glutes
coachTips: Keep chin tucked to chest and eyes forward throughout the thrust.
breathingTip: Inhale at bottom; exhale powerfully as hips thrust up.
progressionNote: Add 5-10kg once you hit 12 solid reps with a locked 1-second pause.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge (Back Safe)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Place a dumbbell across your hips holding it steady with your hands.
Drive through heels to raise hips into full extension.
Squeeze glutes at top, then lower slowly.
coachTips: Fantastic for glute activation and lumbar rehabilitation.
breathingTip: Exhale bridging up; inhale lowering down.
progressionNote: Try single-leg glute bridges for extra challenge.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Fasten ankle cuff to low pulley.
Face the machine, holding onto the frame for stability.
Extend leg straight backward and upward squeezing the glute.
Hold for 1 second, then control back to start.
commonMistakes: Swinging leg wildly and hyperextending lumbar spine
coachTips: Keep movement isolated strictly in the hip joint.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with balls of feet on an elevated step or ledge, heels hanging down.
Lower heels into a deep calf stretch for 1 second.
Rise up as high as possible on the big toes, squeeze calves.
Lower with control.
commonMistakes: Bouncing reps without pausing at stretch and peak
coachTips: Calves respond best to full range: deep 2s stretch, 1s peak squeeze.
progressionNote: Hold dumbbells in hands or do on one leg.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with knees bent at 90 degrees, resting dumbbells on lower thighs.
Raise heels high off the floor by contracting calves.
Hold for 1 second and slowly lower.
coachTips: Bent knee position isolates the soleus muscle beneath the gastrocnemius.
progressionNote: Higher volume (20-25 reps) works exceptionally well for soleus.

name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot near a wall for balance.
Rise up onto toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly until heel touches floor.
commonMistakes: Leaning weight onto the wall support
coachTips: Use light fingertip touch on the wall for balance only.
breathingTip: Exhale on rise; inhale on return.
progressionNote: Hold a dumbbell in the working side hand.
